I believe that sharing a meal is the most honest way to bring people together. This is my invitation to pull up a chair.

Kelyne Noel

I was born in Baham, Cameroun, and spent my early years with my grandmother. My love of food begins with her memory.

On the way to adulthood, I picked up some of her best traits, and people started telling me, « Tu fais une bonne table. » It's what you say about someone who is generous with food and hospitality. Someone whose table is so welcoming nobody ever wants to leave.

À Bonne Table is how I keep her memory alive while sharing my love of food and country. I cook classic and plant-based Cameroonian and West African dishes.

You can pull up a chair wherever you find me: cook-alongs, dinner and market tables, and classes.
